title: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance: alert frequency and email recipients per policy (GCC, GCC High, DoD)

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: Today's documented behaviour sends a single email notification once every 24 hours for any alerts, regardless of matching message count.
claims.quote: A single email notification is sent once every 24 hours for any alerts, regardless of the number of individual messages that match policy conditions.

claims.claim: Existing Communication Compliance alert policies default to simple aggregation.
claims.quote:
For Communication Compliance policies, the system configures the following alert policy values by default:
| Aggregation | Simple aggregation |

claims.claim: The existing alert policy default threshold is 4 activities.
claims.quote: | Threshold | Default: 4 activities  Minimum: 3 activities  Maximum: 2,147,483,647 activities |

claims.claim: The existing alert policy default window is 60 minutes.
claims.quote: | Window | Default: 60 minutes  Minimum: 60 minutes  Maximum: 10,000 minutes |

claims.claim: Existing alert policy triggers for activities, time period and specific users can be changed for Communication Compliance policies.

claims.claim: The Defender route is Email & collaboration > Policies & rules > Alert policy > policy > Actions > Edit > Edit Policy > Trigger settings.

In the Actions column, select the three dots then select Edit.

claims.fix: Keep the documented route and add to controls[0].note: 'In the Actions column, select the three dots, then Edit.' Apply the same clarification to the rendered row. The omitted unlabelled menu does not change the destination.
